svg.aria-label: The session-retro skill for one plan: /session-retro <entry>. Boxes: The window: from the commit that added the plan's plan.md to its last commit (a step of the session); The transcript folders found (a step of the session); The reader, transcript_window.py: what was said and done, each secret redacted (script); A large output (stop); Each output read whole, in parts, into the sessions report (a step of the session); Each point's places and its proposal written, a point decided before left out (a step of the session); The proposals (stop); The report committed, the working folder removed (a step of the session).
